items.title: Burke Stevenson Interview, 1959-06-12
items.q: I remember when he used to take Louis Armstrong on parades, during the First World War. Louis was in short pants then.

ctx.x: Do you remember, uh, Joe Oliver, King Oliver?

Yeah, I remember King Oliver. That's the time, I remember when he used to take Louis Armstrong on parades, during the First World War. Louis was in short pants then. And, uh, and I remember when, uh, Joe Oliver used to play at the Royal Garden, at it on Ramport Street. I remember the night he, he, he quit playing and he left here. They, they raided the place and they, a lot of people jumped up the window, a lot of them broke their legs and things.
Oh really, they broke, I heard about that raid, yeah.
